passive.name: Harrier
passive.description: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies with Harrier. Quinn's first basic attack against Harrier targets will deal bonus physical damage.

primaryAbilities.name: Blinding Assault
primaryAbilities.description: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Quinn orders Valor to dive, making the first enemy hit with Harrier, reducing their vision radius for {{ visionreductionduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to all surrounding enemies.

If the first enemy struck is not a champion, it is Disarmed for {{ visionreductionduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Heightened Senses
primaryAbilities.description: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Harrier target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Attacking a Harrier target grants Quinn {{ attackspeedbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ buffduration }} seconds.

Active: Valor reveals a large area nearby for {{ visionduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Vault
primaryAbilities.description: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and marking them with <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor>. Quinn then leaps backwards from the target, slightly <status>Knocking</status> them <status>Back</status> and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowdecaytime }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Behind Enemy Lines
primaryAbilities.description: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.  Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions with Harrier.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Quinn calls to Valor, pairing up after channeling for 2 seconds gaining {{ movementspeedmod*100 }}% Move Speed and allowing her to Recast this Ability. Attacking or using Blinding Assault or Vault automatically Recasts this Ability.

Recast: Quinn and Valor perform an aerial maneuver, dealing {{ damage }} physical damage, marking champions with Harrier, and ending this Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
